prompt:
Bamboo, the HerbLens panda mascot, in his signature canonical chibi design, shown confused and uncertain. He stands upright on two short stubby legs, head tilted noticeably to the side. One paw rests gently against his cheek as if puzzling over something; the other arm hangs slightly out for balance. His brow is softly furrowed (two short curved charcoal markings above his eyes — not angry, just unsure), eyes are big glossy black with ONE crisp symmetric white highlight each, looking off slightly to one side. A small uncertain closed-mouth smile — the corners just barely turn up, lips a little pursed. Pink blush circles on both cheeks unchanged. One small bamboo-leaf tip peeks from behind each ear.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern app-mascot illustration, like a premium iOS app icon. Flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradient shading (2-3 shade steps, airbrushed falloff). NO painterly brushstrokes, NO paper grain, NO watercolor texture, NO sketchy lines. The silhouette is a clean confident shape that reads at thumbnail size. Subtle darker ambient-occlusion contour under arms and belly, NO hard black outline. Warm single-source light from upper left. Character occupies about 70 percent of frame height, centered, with comfortable margins on all sides (no cropping of ears, paws, or feet). Must read as the same Bamboo character as the canonical reference — fur shape, proportions, markings, eye style identical.
